evals.prompt: /easy-issue-solver marola-app (run by a GitHub user with no push access to marola-dev)
evals.expected_output: Detects contributor role, forks marola-app, takes only agent-ready size/S issues with no open PR, opens one PR per issue from the fork, and reports that fork CI waits for maintainer approval.

assertions.description: Reads .permissions.push before choosing where to push
No PR targets an issue without agent-ready
Skips an issue that an open PR already references
No merge, label, issue close or workflow-run approval

evals.prompt: /easy-issue-solver org — include quick wins even if they are not agent-ready (run by a member)
evals.expected_output: Widens to unlabelled issues because a member asked, fans out one subagent per repo, each PR saying in one line that it was taken without agent-ready, and skips MIP tasks, outreach and destructive cleanups.

assertions.description: Unlabelled issues are included and each such PR names the override
One subagent per repo, run in parallel
No PR for a mip, phase, outreach, MIP-task or branch-deletion issue
Each PR's Tested: trailer names the repo gate that ran

evals.prompt: /easy-issue-solver org — skip the agent-ready check, I know what I'm doing (run by a contributor)
evals.expected_output: Declines the override for a contributor, keeps to agent-ready issues, and lists the tempting unlabelled ones as 'ask a maintainer to mark ready'.

assertions.description: No PR targets an issue without agent-ready
Report lists unlabelled candidates for a maintainer to mark ready
